model_freeze: Use the exact persisted feature order, scaler mean/scale, logistic coefficients/intercept and probability threshold 0.4120041514313575. No coefficient, feature, imputation or threshold change after outcomes.

policy.prefix: Always open seeded challenger and evaluate through index min(H,65). If it exhausts, return incumbent. If any verified challenger endpoint beats incumbent by then, finish the full challenger and return its best verified endpoint.
policy.model_decision: If still unresolved at index65, compute the exact frozen 31-feature vector from only information available at or before index65. Standardize with frozen scaler, evaluate frozen logistic probability, and finish the full challenger iff p>=0.4120041514313575; otherwise return incumbent.
policy.safety: Retain incumbent throughout; final live nodes cannot exceed two-arm.

metrics: Model continuation rate and confusion matrix for eventual challenger benefit
Gain-weighted recall and aggregate gain recovery versus exhaustive challenger
Model vs v1 quality/compute Pareto without same-split retuning

predeclared_usefulness_rule.if_exhaustive_gain_positive: pass only if model recovers >=70% of aggregate exhaustive gain, uses <=60% of exhaustive challenger compilations, has strictly positive gain over two-arm, and has zero per-case harm
predeclared_usefulness_rule.if_exhaustive_gain_zero: report no demonstrated value; do not treat compute reduction as reasoning gain

scope: Synthetic positive-monotone graph 2-CNF ROBDD ordering only. This is a single frozen-model transfer test.
